# Build tools of raisin_master on Ubuntu: what ./raisin (the launcher, raisin build, test and
# cppcheck) runs. apt package names separated by spaces or newlines (one per line by convention),
# '#' starts a comment; version-specific packages go in apt.build.ubuntu-<version>.txt.
# install_system_deps.sh (run by ./raisin --install) installs the ones that are missing, and the raisin-base build image installs
# this list, so its containers need nothing more.

# The launcher creates the raisin virtual environment
python3
python3-venv
python3-virtualenv
python3-pip
# raisin build
cmake
ninja-build
# raisin build configures with the vcpkg toolchain, which bootstraps vcpkg; its
# scripts/bootstrap.sh requires these four
curl
zip
unzip
tar
# raisin setup and the git commands read Git LFS files
git-lfs
# raisin cppcheck
cppcheck
# raisin test --coverage
gcovr
